stops.name: Ponte Brolla
stops.quote: At Ponte Brolla the force of the River Maggia has cleft the rock, gouging out and polishing the gneiss.
stops.english: At Ponte Brolla the force of the River Maggia has cleft the rock, gouging out and polishing the gneiss.

stops.name: Valle del Salto
stops.quote: The itinerary «Valle del Salto» in Maggia leads on nice paths and represents no important differences in height.
stops.english: The itinerary «Valle del Salto» in Maggia leads on nice paths and represents no important differences in height.

stops.name: Gordevio
stops.quote: Plunge into the invigorating waters of the crystal-clear Maggia River, take a walk and listen to the sounds of the magical forest, or start a crackling little fire on a rocky plateau by the shore: days and nights in Gordevio are made for people who want to get close to nature.
stops.english: Plunge into the invigorating waters of the crystal-clear Maggia River, take a walk and listen to the sounds of the magical forest, or start a crackling little fire on a rocky plateau by the shore: days and nights in Gordevio are made for people who want to get close to nature.

stops.name: Bignasco
stops.quote: The Sentiero Cristallina links Bignasco in Valle Maggia with Airolo in Val Bedretto.
stops.english: The Sentiero Cristallina links Bignasco in Valle Maggia with Airolo in Val Bedretto.

stops.name: Lake Sambuco
stops.quote: The road leads through a dense forest of evergreens and past Lake Sambuco until it reaches Lake Narèt at alt. 2310 m.
stops.english: The road leads through a dense forest of evergreens and past Lake Sambuco until it reaches Lake Narèt at alt. 2310 m.

stops.name: Fusio
stops.quote: Boutique Hotel Fusio is set in the peaceful mountain village of Fusio at the far end of the Maggia Valley.
stops.english: Boutique Hotel Fusio is set in the peaceful mountain village of Fusio at the far end of the Maggia Valley.

stops.name: Mario Botta Church in Mogno
stops.quote: Visit the famous Mario Botta Church in the Ticino village of Mogno: A masterpiece of white and black Ticino natural stone in the Maggia Valley.
